title: Frontend scaffold — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's review of PR #61 (frontend-scaffold), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so it isn't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: src/theme/theme.ts's typography.fontFamily lists "Inter" first, but the font is never actually loaded anywhere (no <link> in index.html, no @fontsource/inter or Google Fonts import, no @font-face). Every page silently falls through to the next stack entry (system font) instead of Inter. Either load the font (e.g. @fontsource/inter, imported once in main.tsx or index.html) or drop it from the stack if a system font is actually intended.
